settings.username-change-hint:
Changing your username will make any existing links to your or your members' profiles invalid.
Your username must be unique, be at most 40 characters long, and only contain letters from the basic English alphabet, dashes, underscores, and periods. Your username is used as part of your profile link, you can set a separate display name.
settings.username-update-error:
Could not update your username as the new username is invalid:
{{message}}
settings.force-log-out-hint: If you think one of your tokens might have been compromised, you can log out on all devices by clicking this button.
settings.log-out-hint: Use this button to log out on this device only.

edit-profile.sid-hint: This ID is used in prns.cc links. You can reroll one short ID every hour (shared between your main profile and all members) by pressing the button above.
edit-profile.avatar-updated: Avatar updated! It might take a moment to be reflected on your profile.
edit-profile.member-header-info: This is the text used for the "Members" heading. If you leave it blank, the default text will be used.
edit-profile.timezone-preview: This will show up on your profile like this:
edit-profile.timezone-info: This is optional. Your timezone is never shared directly, only the difference between UTC and your current timezone is.
edit-profile.hide-member-list-info: This only hides your member list. Individual members will still be visible to anyone with a direct link to their pages.
edit-profile.change-username-info: As changing your username will also change all of your members' links, you can only change it in your account settings.
edit-profile.unlisted-note: This only hides this member from your public member list. They will still be visible to anyone at this link:

editor.display-text-info: This is the short text shown on your profile page. If you leave it empty, it will default to the first two forms of the full set.
